annotation_contract.box: Axis-aligned extrema of actually visible owned front face plus frontal rim; exclude rear/top plane and rack/context. Envelope material visible on both sides of an occluder only when it belongs to the same front.
annotation_contract.left_right: Actual physical lower FRONT FACE corners in image-left/right order; a farther side/rim silhouette is not the landmark.
annotation_contract.missing: Use canonical0 0 0 for an unavailable corner; missing alone is not a hold.
annotation_contract.count: Require a visible independent front/owned separator for additions; do not extrapolate instances from spacing or hidden geometry.

review_method: Manual source-pixel inspection of every assigned original and every current r9 row, with enlarged detail crops. Original label files compared where identity/count or inherited point restoration was at issue. No model-generated mask, global shrink/padding, or common point offset used.
